item.title: Mattawa company donates $7,490 to local school breakfast programs
item.description: The funding is geared to supply nutritious breakfasts that they believe will support learning and well-being

item.title: North Bay Battalion pound the IceDogs 9-1 to pass them in the standings
item.description: Ethan Procyszyn had a five point night in North Bay's blowout win. Procyszyn was also a terrific plus five for the contest. The team also announced forward Shamar Moses has gone home for "personal reasons"

item.title: Mattawa council backs call for stronger support of steel and lumber sectors
item.description: In a show of regional solidarity, Mattawa council has endorsed a motion originally proposed by the Township of Nairn and Hyman, calling on the province of Ontario to bolster its support for key resource-based industries

item.title: Two men charged $5,000 for unlawfully selling harvested moose meat
item.description: Two individuals from Northeastern Ontario have been fined a total of $5,000 for unlawfully selling harvested moose meat. Paul Descoteaux of River Valley pleaded guilty and fined $3,500. Kareem Nicolas Rayan St-Germain of River Valley also pleaded guilty to unlawfully selling harvested moose meat. He was fined $1,500. item.title: Funding will allow CT scanner to run for nearly 2,000 additional hours
item.description: New provincial funding will allow the North Bay Health Centre to do more CT scans every year and cut down wait times

item.title: Seven North Bay school bus routes could be shut down by labour disruption
item.description: Parents told to be prepared to make alternative arrangements due to contract negotiations between Alouette Bus Lines and its drivers.

item.title: 2026 East Ferris Winter Carnival packed them in all weekend long
item.description: The 2026 East Ferris Winter Carnival was a monster success on the long weekend

item.title: Big second period powers Battalion to third straight win as North Bay beats Brampton 5-3
item.description: North Bay still trails Peterborough by four points in race for fourth place in the Eastern Conference but these clubs meet in the Petes' arena on Thursday night
